profile.headline: Technical Professional
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer – OTA Platform Technical Program Lead
profile.summary:
Principal-level technical leader with deep experience owning large-scale production systems, OTA platforms, and mission-critical software operations. I specialize in incident management, release readiness, system reliability, and cross-functional execution in complex enterprise environments.

Currently leading OTA production systems supporting vehicle launches, dealer and retail updates, and real-time incident triage. Known for driving clarity during outages, aligning engineering and operations teams, and ensuring high-quality releases without hands-on coding responsibilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer – OTA Platform Technical Program Lead
positions.description:
●	Serve asbtechnical owner for enterprise Over-the-Air (OTA) vehicle update platforms supporting engineering, manufacturing, dealer, and retail software deployments.      
●	Coordinated cross-functional execution of an enterprise migration to a Data Mesh architecture, partnering with engineering teams to support release planning, operational readiness, deployment activities, and production transition.      
●	Lead cross-functional planning and execution for OTA software launches, coordinating engineering, quality, manufacturing, operations, and business stakeholders to ensure successful production delivery.      
●	Drive release readiness activities by validating production preparedness, identifying deployment risks, coordinating dependencies, and supporting successful software releases.      
●	Serve as Technical Triage Lead for high-severity production incidents, directing engineering teams through investigation, root cause analysis, stakeholder communication, and resolution.      
●	Support Engineering Vehicle Launches, Plant Lot OTA Updates, Dealer OTA Updates and Retail OTA Updates 
●	Own end-to-end operational visibility across multiple OTA systems, proactively identifying production risks and coordinating mitigation efforts.      
●	Lead planned and emergency production outages, managing execution, stakeholder communication, recovery activities, and post-event documentation.      
●	Deliver executive reporting on platform health, OTA campaign performance, production risks, release status, and operational metrics.
●	Function as primary domain specialist for OTA campaign governance, planning, execution, and operational reporting.
●	Manage production platform configuration, user access, and production data updates supporting secure testing and software deployment activities.
●	Support SAFe Agile delivery through Azure DevOps (ADO), coordinating work across engineering teams and improving operational execution.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
●	Provide support for break/fix items (replace defective hardware, fix defective software, image computers, etc.)
●	Drive resolution for employee requests (software installations, computer imaging, hardware installation, etc.)
●	Support new employees with their new computer and hardware/systems setups
●	Assist with maintaining and supporting the conferencing environment
●	Actively research, recommend, and POC the latest technologies
●	Work with 3rd party vendors as required
●	Leverage basic Project Management skills as needed to implement various solutions
●	Independently ensure proper use of our ticket management system

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
●	Analyzed customer requirements and suggest appropriate solutions supporting desired outcomes
●	Worked one-on-one with customers to understand problem and suggest appropriate solutions
●	Utilized Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat to create and modify documents as needed
●	Leveraged programming knowledge to define validation, calculations, and process flow logic

positions.title: Software Support Specialist
positions.description:
●	Provided high-quality phone and email support of New World’s software applications
●	Performed extensive troubleshooting of key software and hardware components to closure
●	Took ownership of technical incidents and coordinate resolution with product development team when necessary
●	Replicated of complex customer issues
●	Trained customers in system operation and software functionality

positions.title: Operations Support Analyst II – eC
positions.description:
●	Provided on-call support for Dealer Users, Finance Sources, and OEM’s.
●	Acted as back up for most products (Go-to person)
●	Served as primary second-level support on all escalated tickets for CAS, as well as the subject matter expert on direction and training to the RouteOne Help Desk. 
●	Created Knowledge Base articles on the CAS product
●	Provided additional resources to the RouteOne Help Desk by maintaining the Help Desk ticketing system Knowledge Base (CA Service) as it pertains to CAS issues
●	Maintained CA Service Incidents (assign, comment, close, etc.)
●	Reviewed new features with Help Desk prior to release
●	Worked with the Help Desk to increase agent knowledge of CAS items through Town Halls, training, and Knowledgebase Articles, to enhance first level support.
●	Analyzed and solve issues that cannot be resolved by the RouteOne Service Desk.
●	Provided support to the RouteOne sales team and internal operations teams.
●	Understood all CAS product features and functionality. Worked within teams to identify, clarify, and report back to the service desk on CAS Level 2 support issues in a timely manner.
●	Analyzed problem statements at a high level and developed ability to identify lower-level technical requirements to solve problems.
●	Maintained ownership of tickets throughout troubleshooting, knowing the status, and response, along with follow up with the service desk or dealership in a timely manner.

positions.title: Systems Integrator 1
positions.description:
●	Worked with customer(s) to define information requirements for potential applications
●	Researched available tools and technologies to determine alternative technology solutions
●	Conducted cost/benefit or feasibility analyses to provide recommendations on alternative approaches
●	Developed or acquired, tested, and implemented new or enhanced integrated applications
●	Trained customer(s) on the use of integrated applications to ensure optimal use of the 
application
●	Provided ongoing support for customer(s) for assigned applications including trouble 
shooting and problem resolution
●	Documented the application for technical and customer reference
●	Oversaw all Audio/Visual equipment for the college including systems in each of the classrooms and conference rooms
●	Supported and troubleshooted all Windows and Mac systems for faculty, staff and students

positions.title: Help Desk Analyst
positions.description:
●	Provided comprehensive first-tier phone support for the efficient resolution of technology 
●	problems and requests for end users 
●	Provided complex and unique technical troubleshooting assistance for all end users 
●	Accurately assessed and records support requests and resolutions using a ticketing system
●	Provided issue resolution for end user computing devices 
●	Supported and troubleshooted all Windows Systems for faculty, staff and students
●	Oversaw all Audio/Visual equipment for the school including systems in each of the classrooms

positions.title: System Integrator 1
positions.description:
●	Designed, coded, and tested programs needed to provide support for the English Language Institute and other C&IT projects. 
●	Provided development, support and testing of other Banner Student processes as assigned to maintain and enhance the English Language Institute and users. 
●	Served as a Banner Student English Language Institute subject matter expert who plays a key role for development teams that need to interact with ELI (English Language Institute).
●	Provided support, troubleshooting and resolution of customer issues and problem activities. This included coordinating, testing and verifying the integrity and accuracy of application data. 
●	Participated in the creation of project management related charters. 
●	Provided support for identification of defects, issues, patches and release upgrades of the Banner Student application, as well as support for other initiatives of the ELI and C&IT. 
●	Provided ongoing support for application in production and test environments. 
●	Wrote job aids and helped train customers on the use of new or enhanced functionality for ELI (English Language Institute).

positions.title: Blackboard Administrator
positions.description:
●	Provided support to Blackboard users and administer the Blackboard course management system
●	Retrieved College and District-wide usage statistics
●	Researched and documented ways to improve online learning through Blackboard for the College and  District
●	Initiated and managed the installation of all system updates, upgrades, building blocks, and other software integrated with Blackboard 
●	Maintained a current knowledge of Blackboard enhancements and developments, as well as related software that integrates into the Blackboard system 
●	Planned and presented user training materials and sessions for faculty, staff and students in the institution.
●	Responded to student and faculty correspondence regarding Blackboard issues, requests and maintenance

positions.title: Deskside Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
●	Worked on special projects (including Bitlocker Drive Encryption Project)
●	Re-staged company machines
●	Provided desktop and phone support of Ford employee’s PCs using Windows XP, Vista and Windows 7 Operating Systems

positions.title: Help Desk Technician II - Blackboard Support
positions.description:
●	Accessed, identify, isolate, translate and resolve customer problems with Blackboard and associated technologies
●	Answered Blackboard support requests via phone calls, email and in person.
●	Tested and document functionality during “off hours” when required
●	Assisted with training other HDAs and/or students in Blackboard and associated technologies
●	Assisted with reviewing documentation

positions.title: Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
●	Provided technical assistance to students, faculty and staff of Wayne State University
●	Provided troubleshooting assistance for computer related problems including software and hardware issues
●	Acted as team lead to approximately 10 people
●	Acted as ResNet (Resident Network) Technician where responsibilities included troubleshooting internet connection problems for residents in Wayne State University dorms or apartments

positions.title: Student Assistant - Help Desk/Tech Support
positions.description:
●	Performed clerical duties
●	Assisted customers with Laptop troubleshooting problems
●	Maintained printer and printouts in school computer lab
●	Answered telephone and customer’s inquiries
●	Monitored imaging and worked with Microsoft Windows-based software and operating systems
